meta.review_notes: OpenAI's privacy policy is unusually transparent about model training. Key concerns: all user Content (prompts, files, images, audio) is used to improve models unless explicitly opted out; contact sync uploads full address book; free users receive personalized ads from multiple partners including data about purchases from advertisers; business account administrators can access user Content; content is monitored for safety. Key positives: users own their Output; can opt out of training; Temporary Chats are not saved or used for training; can delete individual conversations or entire account; can export data; de-identified data is not re-identified.

app.name: ChatGPT
app.description: An AI-powered assistant for writing, analysis, coding, creative projects, and learning, built by OpenAI.

verdict.one_liner: Everything you type into ChatGPT is logged and may be used to train AI models, but you can opt out, delete chats, and use Temporary Chat for privacy.
verdict.summary: ChatGPT collects all user Content (prompts, files, images, audio, video) and extensive usage data. By default, this Content is used to train and improve OpenAI's models, though users can opt out. Free users receive personalized ads from multiple advertising partners, and may receive data about purchases from advertisers. Business account administrators can access employee Content. However, users retain ownership of Output, can delete conversations or their entire account, can export data, and can use Temporary Chat which is not saved or used for training.
verdict.recommendation_reason: ChatGPT is powerful and useful, but everything you type is logged by OpenAI. If privacy is important, turn on Temporary Chat, opt out of model training in Settings, and avoid sharing sensitive personal information.

red.title: Your conversations are used to train AI models by default
red.plain_english: By default, everything you type, upload, or say to ChatGPT is stored and may be used to train and improve OpenAI's AI models. You can opt out in Settings, but most users don't know to do this.

red.title: Contact Sync uploads your full address book
red.plain_english: If you enable Contact Sync, ChatGPT uploads your entire device address book to see which of your contacts also use the service. Even contacts who don't use ChatGPT have their data uploaded.

red.title: Free users get personalized ads from multiple partners
red.plain_english: If you use ChatGPT for free, OpenAI shows you personalized ads and works with advertising partners like Meta, Google, and others who track your activity to target ads.

red.title: Business account admins can read all your ChatGPT conversations
red.plain_english: If you sign up with a work email or join a ChatGPT Enterprise account, your company's administrators can access and control your account, including reading everything you generate in ChatGPT.

red.title: OpenAI monitors your conversations for safety and policy enforcement
red.plain_english: OpenAI reviews the content you submit to detect fraud, abuse, illegal activity, and policy violations. This means your private conversations are subject to automated and potentially human review.

red.title: Advertisers may share your purchase data with OpenAI
red.plain_english: OpenAI receives information about purchases you make from advertisers and data partners. This purchase data is used to measure and improve ad effectiveness.

green.title: You own the output that ChatGPT generates for you
green.plain_english: OpenAI assigns all rights to the AI-generated responses to you. As between you and OpenAI, you own the Output from your conversations.

green.title: You can opt out of having your chats used to train models
green.plain_english: ChatGPT gives you a real, working setting to stop your conversations from being used to train OpenAI's AI models. This is found in your account's Data Controls.

green.title: Temporary Chat conversations are not saved or used for training
green.plain_english: You can enable Temporary Chat mode, which means your conversation won't appear in your history and won't be used to improve OpenAI's models.

green.title: You can delete conversations or your entire account, and export your data
green.plain_english: You have full control to delete individual chats, all chats, or your entire account. You can also export a copy of all your ChatGPT data.

green.title: De-identified data is not re-identified
green.plain_english: When OpenAI anonymizes your data for research, they promise not to attempt to re-identify it, unless required by law.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT only uses your microphone and camera when you actively choose to upload audio, images, or video. There is no background access.
categories.detail: Camera and microphone access is entirely user-initiated for optional features: voice mode (audio input), image inputs (camera or gallery), and video uploads. These features are not required for basic text-based chat. There is no background camera or microphone access.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect Personal Data that you provide in the input to our Services, including your prompts and other content you upload, such as files, images, audio and video.
concerns: Uploaded audio, images, and video are stored and may be used for training unless opted out

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT does not need your GPS location. It estimates your general area from your IP address for security and to provide more accurate responses.
categories.detail: No precise GPS location is required. OpenAI determines the general area from the device's IP address for security purposes (detecting unusual login activity) and to improve response accuracy. Some features allow users to optionally provide more precise location information from device GPS.
categories.policy_excerpt: We determine the general area from which your device accesses our Services based on information like its IP address for security reasons and to make your product experience better.
concerns: IP-based location inference is always active

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you enable Contact Sync, ChatGPT uploads your entire address book to see which contacts also use the service. This includes people who don't use ChatGPT.
categories.detail: Contact Sync is an optional feature that uploads information from the device's address book. OpenAI checks which contacts use their Services and notifies users if contacts sign up later. The uploaded contact information is used to identify existing users and may be used for other purposes described in the help center. Core chat functionality does not require contact access.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you choose to connect your device contacts, we upload information from your device address books and check which of your contacts also use our Services.
concerns: Full address book uploaded including non-ChatGPT users
Contact data used to identify and notify about new signups
Unclear secondary uses of uploaded contact data

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT only accesses your files, photos, or videos when you actively choose to upload them into a conversation. There is no background scanning of your device storage.
categories.detail: File and media access is entirely user-initiated for uploading files, images, audio, and video as inputs to ChatGPT. There is no indication of broad library scanning or background file access. Uploaded content is processed by OpenAI's models and stored.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect Personal Data that you provide in the input to our Services, including your prompts and other content you upload, such as files, images, audio and video.
concerns: Uploaded files may be used to train models unless opted out
Sensitive documents uploaded for analysis are stored on OpenAI servers

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: OpenAI shares your data with service providers, advertising partners, affiliates, business account administrators, and government authorities. If you use ChatGPT through Apple's integrations, your data is handled according to Apple's terms too.
categories.detail: OpenAI shares Personal Data with: vendors and service providers (hosting, customer service, cloud, analytics, payment processors, age verification, IT), marketing partners for promoting OpenAI on third-party properties, affiliates under common control, business account administrators (who can access Content for Enterprise/business accounts), government authorities and industry peers for legal compliance and safety, and other users when sharing conversations or content publicly. Information is also received from advertisers about purchases, and from publicly available internet sources for model training.
categories.policy_excerpt: We disclose Personal Data to vendors, service providers, and marketing partners, including providers of hosting services, customer service vendors, cloud services, content delivery services, support and safety services, email communication software, web analytics services, payment and transaction processors, search and shopping providers, and information technology providers.
concerns: Multiple advertising and marketing partners receive data
Business account administrators can access employee Content
Advertisers share purchase data about users
Publicly available internet data used for model training
Government disclosures for legal requests

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT requires your name, email, date of birth, and account credentials. If you sign up with a work email, your employer may be notified and gain control of your account.
categories.detail: Account creation requires name, contact information, account credentials, date of birth, payment information (for paid accounts), and transaction history. Optional profile information includes profile picture and username. Social login via Google or Facebook imports additional data. If using a corporate email domain, the organization may be notified and the account transferred to business administration. Age verification may require identity documentation through third-party vendors.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create an account with us, we will collect information associated with your account, including your name, contact information, account credentials, date of birth, payment information, and transaction history.
concerns: Corporate email domains may trigger business account transfer
Age verification may require identity documentation
Social login imports additional profile data

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: If you use ChatGPT for free, OpenAI shows you personalized ads based on your activity. They also work with advertising partners who track you across other websites, and may receive data about your purchases from advertisers.
categories.detail: For Free and Go users, OpenAI personalizes ads shown on their Services and measures ad effectiveness. They work with marketing analytics service providers, website analysis firms, and third-party advertising networks. Marketing partners receive limited information through cookies and similar technologies to promote OpenAI products on third-party properties. OpenAI may receive information about purchases users make from advertisers. Users under 18 are not targeted with these activities. Free users can control ad personalization in account settings.
categories.policy_excerpt: For Free and Go users, to personalize the ads you see on our Services (subject to your settings), and to measure the effectiveness of ads shown on our Services.
concerns: Personalized ads for free users based on activity data
Cross-site tracking by advertising partners via cookies
Purchase data received from advertisers
No opt-out available for free users beyond settings controls

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT is not for children under 13. Users 13-17 need parent or guardian permission. Teen accounts can optionally link to a parent account for safety monitoring.
categories.detail: Services are not directed to children under 13. OpenAI does not knowingly collect data from children under 13. Users under 18 must have parent or guardian permission. Teen users can choose to link their account to a parent/guardian account, allowing the parent to manage settings and receive safety alerts. These linked accounts can be unlinked at any time. OpenAI does not engage in targeted advertising for users known to be under 18.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our Services are not directed to, or intended for, children under 13. We do not knowingly collect Personal Data from children under 13. Users under 18 must have permission from their parent or guardian to use our Services.
concerns: No robust age verification — relies on self-attestation
Teen account linking requires voluntary parent participation

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT requires internet access to work. OpenAI logs your IP address, browser type, when you use the app, and how you interact with it. This data is retained as long as your account exists.
categories.detail: Continuous internet access is required for AI processing. OpenAI collects extensive log data: IP address, browser type and settings, date/time of requests, interaction patterns. Usage data includes content viewed, features used, actions taken, feedback submitted, people interacted with, timezone, country, access dates/times, user agent, device type, and computer connection. Atlas browser data is also collected according to user controls.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information that your browser or device automatically sends when you use our Services. Log data includes your Internet Protocol address, browser type and settings, the date and time of your request, and how you interact with our Services.
concerns: Extensive interaction logging including every feature used and action taken
IP address logged and retained for account lifetime
Atlas browser data collected with user controls

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: OpenAI collects your device name, operating system, device identifiers, and browser information to identify your device and improve the service.
categories.detail: Device information collected includes: device name, operating system, device identifiers, and browser type. Cookies and similar technologies are used to operate and administer services, maintain preferences across sessions, assist with authentication, and support customer service. Information depends on device type and settings. Some identifiers may be used for advertising and analytics purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about the device you use to access the Services, such as the name of the device, operating system, device identifiers, and browser you are using.
concerns: Device identifiers may be used for ad targeting
Cookies track preferences and authentication across sessions
Device fingerprinting persists across app reinstalls

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT does not collect health or biometric data. Any voice data you upload for voice mode is processed as audio content, not biometric identification.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collection is mentioned in the privacy policy. Audio uploaded for voice mode is treated as User Content for AI processing, not used for biometric identification or voice profiling. Facial recognition is not mentioned. Age verification may require identity documents but this is processed by third-party vendors for verification purposes only.
categories.policy_excerpt: No health or biometric data collection described in the policy.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT only collects payment information if you subscribe to Plus, Pro, or other paid plans. The free version requires no payment data.
categories.detail: Payment data is only collected for optional paid subscriptions (ChatGPT Plus, Pro, etc.). Transaction history is retained as part of Account Information. Payment and transaction information may be retained longer for accounting, dispute resolution, and regulatory compliance. Free tier usage requires no financial information.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create an account with us, we will collect... payment information, and transaction history.
concerns: Transaction data retained for accounting and regulatory compliance
Purchase history used for fraud prevention and dispute resolution

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete individual chats, all chats, or your entire account. You can export your data. However, some data is kept for safety, legal, or fraud prevention reasons even after deletion.
categories.detail: Users have strong deletion controls: delete specific conversations, all conversations, Saved Memories, or the entire account. Data is removed within 30 days of deletion request unless retention is required for safety, legal, or financial reasons. Temporary Chats are automatically deleted within 30 days. Atlas incognito browsing history is not saved after session ends. Users can export ChatGPT history and data. However: banned accounts may retain data to protect services; legal subpoenas may require retention; payment records kept for accounting; erasure request audit records retained for compliance verification.
categories.policy_excerpt: Once you choose to delete Personal Data, we will remove it from our systems within 30 days unless we need to retain it for longer as described below.
concerns: Banned accounts retain data for fraud/abuse prevention
Legal subpoenas may require extended retention
Payment records retained for accounting/compliance
Content already used for model training may persist in model weights

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: OpenAI updates the privacy policy on their website. For material adverse changes to the Terms, they give at least 30 days notice. By continuing to use ChatGPT, you accept any updates.
categories.detail: Privacy policy updates are published on the website with an updated effective date. Terms changes that materially adversely impact users require at least 30 days advance notice via email or in-product notification. All other changes are effective upon posting. Users who do not agree must stop using the Services.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will give you at least 30 days advance notice of changes to these Terms that materially adversely impact you either via email or an in-product notification.
concerns: Continued use constitutes acceptance of non-material changes
Only material adverse changes get 30-day notice
